name: boj_get_inflation
description:
Japanese consumer prices, monthly, from the IMF CPI dataflow (all items): cpi is the index level (JPN.CPI._T.IX.M), cpi_inflation the percent change on a year earlier (JPN.CPI._T.YOY_PCH_PA_PT.M). FRED's Japanese CPI ended in 2021 and its PPI is gone, so core CPI and PPI are not offered.
Returns: series_code (FRED id, or IMF flow.key), series_id, label, source, observation_count and observations (date, value) oldest first, missing values dropped.
Inputs (none required): index_type (cpi, cpi_inflation; default cpi); start_date, end_date (YYYY-MM-DD); recent_periods (1-500; default 10; the last N observations, used only when neither date is given).
For GDP, unemployment and trade use boj_get_economic_indicator. IMF series need no key.
Example: {"index_type": "cpi_inflation", "recent_periods": 13}

index_type.description: cpi: index level; cpi_inflation: % change on a year earlier

recent_periods.description: The last N observations; used only when neither date is given
